title: How Do Tides Work? Spring Tides vs. Neap Tides | Space Atlas
description: Tides come from a stretching effect, not a simple pull — Earth bulges on both sides. See how the Sun adds to or cancels that effect.
ogDescription: Why are there two high tides a day, not one? And why are spring tides stronger than neap tides? A force diagram, not a photo.
jsonldDescription: A force-diagram explanation of tidal bulges on both the near and far sides of Earth, and how spring and neap tides result from the Sun and Moon's relative alignment.
